purpose: Diagnostic only: compare complete LIVE_CONDITIONAL likelihoods without inventing benchmark exposure.

definition.status: NOT an ordinary SelectionScore and must not assign importance tier by itself

interpretation.keyFinding: LIVE_CONDITIONAL candidates differ by orders of magnitude in information per eligible trial, so treating all unresolved-benchmark candidates as the same informational class discards reproducible information.
interpretation.manifestGap: v8.2 has no canonical exposure-independent diagnostic/selection metadata for complete conditional likelihoods when benchmark exposure remains unresolved.
interpretation.guardrail: Do not convert per-trial strength into a 7000G SelectionScore, importance tier, or likelihood weight without actual observed trials or a resolved benchmark exposure.

next: continue zero-base research to see whether a generic per-trial metric is sufficient metadata or whether v8.2 needs a manifest amendment before Selection construction
